newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FPL Group lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FPL Group lowered to hold.

text.p: Gruntal & Co LLC said on Tuesday it lowered its rating on the shares of FPL Group Inc to a hold from a buy because the stock price was nearing the firm's $49 per share price target.

-- Analyst Penelope Adelmann said in a research note she recommended investors hold FPL Group for steady ongoing returns, while investors seeking more growth and capital appreciation should consider switching to other utilities.
-- "We continue to believe that FPL Group is one of the most solid energy companies in our universe," she said.
